Results.ReviewText: So far, love the build quality and design of the grill with one exception.   My only complaint to date, and I've only had the grill for approximately a month, is when the lid is open to turn your items on the grill, all of the heat,  and mainly smoke, is directed straight into your face.  Not sure if I'm just unlucky, or if it's because of the design of the lid,  but what I can tell you is that it's extremely aggravating.  It's especially bad when cooking something greasy, like hamburger patties.  Other than that issue,  I am happy with the build quality of the grill and the cooking performance as well.
Results.Title: Great grill, but....

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber gas grill, and so far I am really pleased. 45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
